title: Cursor Cuts Prices, Adds Controls Amid AI Tokenomics Reckoning
excerpt: Cursor's aggressive price cuts and new enterprise spend controls signal the end of the 'unlimited AI' era in development workflows. Companies are finally confronting the true cost of generative AI as the tokenomics crisis arrives.
post_draft:
Have you checked your AI tool bills lately?

Cursor just slashed prices and added spending caps—and it's a sign that the "unlimited AI" dream is officially over.

In our latest piece, we break down what's really happening: companies are finally waking up to the true cost of generative AI in their development workflows. The tokenomics crisis is here, and it's forcing vendors to get real about pricing.

You'll learn why price cuts matter less than spend controls, how this shift affects enterprise security, and what your team should expect from AI dev tools going forward.

The era of burning cash on unlimited token usage is ending. Smart teams are already adapting.

Read the full story and see what's coming next for AI in development and testing.
